updater.availableBody:
Shota {version} is available ~ you have {current}.

Shota will restart once it's installed.
updater.failedBody:
Shota couldn't install the update: {error}

You can download it manually from the releases page.

overlay.dragHint: Drag to select an area · Space to switch to window mode · Esc to cancel
overlay.snapHint: Click a window to capture it · Space to go back

settings.registerFailed: That combo couldn't be registered ~ try another.
settings.printScreenOwned: Windows is using Print Screen for the Snipping Tool, so Shota never sees it.
settings.languageHint: Shota follows your Windows language unless you pick one here.
settings.shortcutsHint: Click a shortcut, then press the keys you want. Esc cancels.
settings.areaHint: Hold Space while selecting to snap to a window.
settings.historyHint: Your recent captures, ready to reopen or copy.
settings.tagline: A free, native Windows screenshot and annotation tool.
settings.storeUpdates: Updates arrive through the Microsoft Store.
settings.license: Free and open source under the MIT licence.
settings.startupHint: Start Shota in the tray when you sign in to Windows.
settings.startupBlockedByUser: Turned off in Task Manager. Turn Shota back on under Startup apps there.
settings.startupBlockedByPolicy: Your administrator has turned this off.
settings.startupFailed: Windows wouldn't change this ~ try again.
settings.needsModifier: Add Ctrl, Alt or Shift to {keys}, or it would fire while you type in other apps.
settings.reservedKey: {keys} keeps its usual job in the editor.
settings.fixedKeys: Esc, Delete, Space and Enter keep their usual jobs in the editor and can't be reassigned.
settings.saveFolderLast: The last folder you saved to
settings.formatHint: Copy always uses PNG, which every app can paste.
settings.qualityHint: Lower makes smaller files, higher keeps more detail.
settings.historyIntro: Captures stay on this computer so you can reopen them with the history shortcut.
settings.clearHistoryConfirm: Delete every capture in history? This can't be undone.
settings.tokensBody: Shota is free, for good. It was built with a lot of AI help, and AI help is billed in tokens, so tokens are the honest thing to ask for.
settings.tokensFree: Or star it on GitHub, which is free and helps a lot

error.title: Shota hit a problem
error.body: Something in this window crashed. Closing and capturing again usually clears it.
